# Harbor Table

Harbor Table is a small restaurant booking desk shipped with AgentReady so the scanner has real routes to classify. Humans book a table on /demo. Agents should use the HTTP APIs.

- [Booking desk](/demo)
- [List and create reservations](/api/bookings)
- [Reservation by id](/api/bookings/{id})
- [Search reservations](/api/search)
- [OpenAPI spec](/openapi.json)
